week.name: Today
week.detailed: Rain likely before 2pm. Partly sunny, with a high near 46. West wind around 3 mph. Chance of precipitation is 60%.

week.name: Sunday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny. High near 52, with temperatures falling to around 49 in the afternoon. South southeast wind around 3 mph.

week.name: Monday
week.detailed: Partly sunny, with a high near 55. South southwest wind around 3 mph.
week.night_short: Mostly Cloudy then Chance Light Rain

week.name: Tuesday
week.short: Light Rain then Rain And Snow
week.detailed: Rain before 5pm, then rain and snow. Cloudy, with a high near 50. New rainfall amounts between a quarter and half of an inch possible.

week.name: Wednesday
week.short: Partly Sunny then Slight Chance Rain And Snow
week.detailed: A slight chance of rain and snow after 5pm. Partly sunny, with a high near 44.

week.name: Thursday
week.detailed: Rain and snow. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 44. Little or no snow accumulation expected.

week.name: Friday
week.detailed: Rain and snow. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 40. New snow accumulation of less than one inch possible.

discussion.key_messages: - Guidance is trending slightly warmer with the upcoming two storms on Tuesday/Wednesday and Thursday/Friday which will limit the valley snow potential. - There is still a high amount of uncertainty regarding the late week storm.
